title: Inclusion of POFMA Correction Direction on Main Page of Asia Sentinel Website and Page Hosting Article with False Statement of Fact
what_it_is: Inclusion of POFMA Correction Direction on Main Page of Asia Sentinel Website and Page Hosting Article with False Statement of Fact

sections.label: Correction Direction to Asia Sentinel
sections.summary: The Minister for Home Affairs instructed the POFMA Office to issue a Correction Direction to Asia Sentinel requiring a Correction Notice at the article page top and website main page top.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In the case of Asia Sentinel, the Minister for Home Affairs had instructed the POFMA Office to issue a Correction Direction to Asia Sentinel in respect of one of its articles and specified that the recipient publish a Correction Notice at: one, the top of the page which hosts the article that contained false statements of fact; and two, the top of the main page of its website.

sections.label: Correction Directions to online sites
sections.summary: The question asks how many Correction Directions have been issued to online sites, including this rendition covering the article and entire website.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The second question I have is how many Correction Directions have been issued to online sites, which include this particular rendition of the Correction Direction – not just for the article, but for the entire website as well?

sections.label: Need for this tool
sections.summary: The speaker says they do need this type of tool and lacks details on specific Correction Directions and which used this tool versus other Correction Notices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We do try and so, we do need this type of tool.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I do not have the details about the specific Correction Directions and which used this tool versus the other types of Correction Notices.

sections.label: Past Asia Sentinel Correction Notices
sections.summary: The question asks whether Asia Sentinel had received a Correction Notice for other articles and ignored it, leading to a heightened approach for a subsequent article.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Can I confirm whether a Correction Notice had been given to Asia Sentinel for other articles in the past and their conduct had been egregious in that they ignored it and, hence, a more heightened approach was taken with them for the subsequent article which contained false statements of fact?

sections.label: Asia Sentinel non-adherence question
sections.summary: The question asks whether Asia Sentinel previously did not adhere to Correction Directions, leading the Government to take a firmer approach over a course of conduct.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Has there been a situation where Asia Sentinel in the past did not adhere to Correction Directions which led the Government to turn the screw and say, "Look, I think you are pursuing a certain course of conduct which requires us to do this"?

sections.label: Correction Notices with website requirement
sections.summary: The question asks how many other Correction Notices included the requirement covering not just the article but the main website as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: But how many times has Asia Sentinel or any other publication – I do not have a particular interest in Asia Sentinel, it is more the approach of the Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: So, perhaps, I will look forward to some information from the Senior Minister of State about how many other Correction Notices have included this requirement, not just the article but the main website as well.

sections.label: Website design and Correction Direction
sections.summary: The design, feed, user behaviour, content and notice are taken into account, and Asia Sentinel did not comply with the Correction Direction on 26 May.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we take into account the design of the website, the feed, the way in which user behaviour is guided by that, but also the kind of content and the kind of notice that is required.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would point out that if Mr Singh is concerned about past track records, Asia Sentinel did not comply with the Correction Direction on 26 May, so, then an access blocking order was issued.

sections.label: Asia Sentinel non-compliance with Correction Direction
sections.summary: Asia Sentinel did not comply with the entire Correction Direction in the required time or place the Correction Notice at the top of the main webpage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: And I think this is my understanding and the Senior Minister of State can correct me if it is wrong.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They are required to comply with the entirety of the Correction Direction and Asia Sentinel did not comply with the entire Correction Direction in the time required.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They also did not comply with the requirement to have the Correction Notice at the top of the main webpage and they had changed the design by including another article.
